#### Veeam

**Infrastructure Components**

This dashboard gives visibility into Infrastructure Components in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique hosts, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces top repositories, proxies, and infrastructure hosts. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer an infrastructure-operations view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
